question: The production of bottles rose to 26000 from 16000 in 2 years. Find the rate of growth per annum.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Rate of Growth = [ √(Final Value ÷ Initial Value) − 1 ] × 100

Rate = [ √(26000 ÷ 16000) − 1 ] × 100

Rate = [ √1.625 − 1 ] × 100

Rate ≈ [ 1.2747 − 1 ] × 100 ≈ 27.47% ≈ 27.5%

**∴ The correct answer is 27.5%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial production (P) = 16000

Final production (A) = 26000

Time (n) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

A = P × (1 + R/100)ⁿ
